feeds.title: Glamour UK
feeds.description: Glamour Magazine UK is an online magazine with an emphasis on entertainment, beauty, fashion, and leisure. It provides features, articles, and guidance on a range of subjects, including empowering stories, cosmetic tips, fashion trends, and celebrity news. In addition, the website has product reviews, interviews with prominent people, and audience-interactive material.

feeds.title: Birds on the Blog
feeds.description: Birds on the Blog is a blog that inspires and motivates business women. Our mission is to challenge the stereotypes, to eliminate feminism as a dirty word and to connect, empower and inspire as many women as possible, no matter where they are in the world.

feeds.title: Midlifechic » Style
feeds.description: Midlife Chic is a UK blog for women over 40 who are getting their groove back. Written by the former editor of Selfridges magazine, it focuses on classic chic featuring high street fashion and beauty. It is a forum for midlife women to discuss the issues that they face as they enter into the second half of their life.

feeds.title: Women's Running
feeds.description: Women's Running focuses on women's running training advice for 5K, 10K, half marathons and marathons, female-specific kit reviews, and women's running shoe reviews. Women's Running Magazine is the UK's lifestyle magazine for women who run. The magazine has been going for more than 12 years, and in that time it has inspired thousands of women to enjoy running and to progress further than they ever thought possible.
